entries.name: Bachelor of Applied Public Health
entries.reason: Confirmed via acu.edu.au/handbook: this plain (non-Honours) award existed through the 2023 handbook (real course page, real unit schedule) but returns a soft-404 handbook landing page for 2024, 2025, 2026 and 2027, and has no marketing page at /course/bachelor-of-applied-public-health. The current live ACU award in this family is Bachelor of Applied Public Health (Honours), a different one-year graduate-entry course, not this row.

entries.name: Bachelor of International Development Studies
entries.reason: Confirmed via acu.edu.au/handbook: real standalone award through the 2024 handbook (real course page, real unit schedule) but soft-404 for 2025, 2026 and 2027, with no current marketing page. International Development Studies now exists only as a Major (acu.edu.au/handbook/handbook-2026/major/international-development-studies) within other degrees, not as its own standalone award.

entries.name: Bachelor of Commerce
entries.reason: Confirmed via acu.edu.au/handbook: real standalone award through the 2026 handbook (real course page, real unit schedule) but soft-404 for the current 2027 handbook year, and /course/bachelor-of-commerce marketing page also resolves to the generic Find a Course listing (soft-404), confirming no new-student intake for this award.

entries.name: Bachelor of Business Administration
entries.reason: Confirmed via acu.edu.au/handbook: real standalone award through the 2025 handbook (real course page, real unit schedule) but soft-404 for 2026 and 2027 handbook years, and /course/bachelor-of-business-administration marketing page also resolves to the generic Find a Course listing (soft-404), confirming no new-student intake for this award.
